patterns: Debt-humility confessions are today's breakout: a wholesaler going from 106 deals to 1 and saying 'stress-test for a bigger drop' jumped from 5.7k to 30.5k overnight
'Then vs. now' math is the format that keeps working: same house, old numbers, today's numbers, 'the math doesn't work'
Cost-to-build outrage pulls replies (61.5k, 127 replies on a cement-price post); people argue about whether ownership is still possible for regular people
Rent-anxiety posts have stopped growing (44.8k flat); the energy has moved to 'can a normal person still get in?'
Philly: state zoning reform talk is still climbing slowly; nobody local owns that conversation yet

virals_narrative: Scanned X since Nov 3 for rentals, first homes, seller finance, wholesaling, creative finance and Philly housing. One new 10k+ star (a first-rental build-cost vent at 61.5k) and Jacob_Naviaux's debt confession jumped to 30.5k. Rent-anxiety posts are flat. Nothing new from the watchlist to score.
narrative_synthesis: The meta moved from 'how do I stop renting' to 'can a regular person still get in, and what did debt cost people who did'. Drafts: (1) a then-vs-now Philly numbers post Bar fills with real figures, (2) a debt-discipline take, (3) a Philly zoning question.

drafts.draft_en:
Same Philly rowhome. Two different eras.

Then: bought for [$___], rent [$___]/mo, payment [$___]
Now: it'd cost [$___], rent [$___]/mo, payment [$___]

The deals didn't disappear. They moved to people who know how to structure them.
drafts.pattern: then-vs-now numbers (Jacob_Naviaux 6.7k, 'the math doesn't work'). Fill only with real figures from a deal you know; don't post with placeholders.
drafts.video_tip: Split-screen talking head, 25s: 'then' numbers on the left, 'now' on the right, appearing as you say them. End on the last line to camera.

drafts.draft_en:
Debt feels great on the way up.

The investors still standing this year didn't have better deals. They had lower personal burn.

Build the business with leverage. Build your life like income could drop 80%.

That's how you build a legacy that survives a bad year.
drafts.pattern: debt-humility confession (Jacob_Naviaux 30.5k, 106 deals to 1). Lesson-first framing in your own voice, no borrowed numbers.
drafts.video_tip: Walk-and-talk, 20s, one line per cut. Put '80%' big on screen at the key line.

drafts.draft_en:
Harrisburg is talking about state-level zoning reform.

If Philly loses some control over what gets built, does that help renters get to ownership faster, or just help big developers?

Philly investors, what's your read?
drafts.pattern: Philly local signal (nextphlmayor 2.5k and climbing) plus the 'can regular people still get in' debate. Question post to pull replies.
drafts.video_tip: Selfie video on a Philly block with an empty lot or rowhomes behind you, 15s, ask the question and point to the comments.
